voiceover_full: Every device on the internet has a home address. Here's why. To mail a letter, you need a street, a city and a zip code. Without an address, the mail carrier has no idea where to go. An IP address is that address for your phone, laptop or server. Data uses it to find the right device. But what if you only know a name? That's next. Follow for part 2.
